JUDGMENT
IN THE SUPREME COURT OF INDIA
CIVIL APPELLATE JURISDICTION
CIVIL APPEAL NO.        OF 2013 (D 7961/2013)
C.C.E., AHMEDABAD
 APPELLANT
                 VERSUS
M/S.KIRI DYES & CHEMICALS LTD.                    RESPONDENT
O R D E R
1.
We  have  heard  Shri  H.P.Raval,  learned  Additional 
Solicitor General of India, appearing for the appellant. 
2.
After  hearing  the  learned  A.S.G.,  we  are  of  the 
opinion that this appeal deserves to be dismissed only on the 
ground of delay.  
3.
Accordingly,  the  Civil  Appeal  is  dismissed  on  the 
ground of delay.
